Shri Satya Pal Chadar - Government Advocate for the r
 /State.
 Shri Ritik Sharma - Advocate for the Objector.

Order 
This is first bail application filed under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant Rohit (483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023).
2.

The applicant is in jail since 22.07.2024 in connection with Crime No.230 of 2024 registered at P.S. Shahjahanabad, District- Bhopal for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366(A),
376(2)(N), 376(3), 344, 506 of IPC and under Section 3/4, 5, 6 of POCSO Act.
3. Prosecution story in brief is that at alleged date, time and place, applicant committed penetrated sexual assault on prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is also urged that no injuries have been found on the person of prosecutrix.
After investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
Applicant is in custody since 22.07.2024.
On above grounds, NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:55740 2 MCRC-45223-2024 it is urged that applicant be released on bail.
It is also argued that learned counsel for the Objector has no objection if applicant is released on bail.

sentences.text: Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.
However, learned counsel for the Objector has no objection if applicant is released on bail.
6. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
10. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE RC Rohit Masane vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186806097/
